# test/fixtures — Small committed slices of the real export (never exports/ itself, which is gitignored at 657 MB) plus golden files. Fixtures must be trimmed by script from exports/ so they can be regenerated, not hand-edited. `templates/` is stage 3's: `manifest.json` (all 11 template rows) and `parsed.golden.json`, regenerated by `templates/extract.ts`. `render/` is stage 4's: `cards.json` (19 real cards chosen for the constructs they carry), plus `templates.golden.html` and `cards.golden.html` — the serialised DOM those inputs render to — regenerated by `render/extract.ts`. A golden diff is the point: it is how a renderer change that nobody meant to make becomes visible.
